about: Phase ranges from the approved reference algorithm design/code/cycle.ts (phaseRanges) for every valid combination of cycle length 21-45, period length 2-10 and luteal length 10-16. Ranges are [firstDay, lastDay] for menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, luteal. This fixture proves the Dart port matches the reference exactly; it does not validate the medical assumptions behind the algorithm.
